- [ ] No hard-coded paths (use config, not literal file paths)
- [ ] Seed is fixed, not random, if this touches the generator
- [ ] No new tool, library, service, or account introduced without a decision log entry (D-002 condition 3)
- [ ] If this changes a business parameter, it cites the decision ID that set it (e.g. `# D-003`, `# D-006`)
- [ ] CI is green
